qa_pairs.question: What component is designated as 1AZ in the distributor section?
What is the difference in torque between M20 and M10/M30 distributor screws?
qa_pairs.answer: M20 screws require 22 Nm while M10/M30 screws require 10 Nm, a difference of 12 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which distributor component has the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The distributor rotor to adapter with DME (2AZ) has the lowest torque at 2.8 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers these distributor torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-1 Engine Electrical Equipment, subsection 12.11 Distributor
